GROUND is recorded and the option comparison is ready. Before I go on to the measurable requirements and concepts, I need your approval of the material and process choice (the INTENT gate).

## What's recorded
Your answers are in the record. Everything you left open is written down as a labelled assumption (ASM-001 to ASM-008) in DR-001; none of them counts as a measured fact. The record check passes.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Use class | working prototype: 4 sets in real indoor use, low consequence (assumed, ASM-001) |
| Documentation depth | `pro` |
| Loads | 30 N at 80 mm, two worst cases: closing against the 0° stop and opening against the 75° stop |
| Environment | indoor, 15–35 °C, dry, no sun, no heat sources (assumed, ASM-002) |
| Drawing general tolerance | ISO 2768-c (assumed, ASM-004) |
| Strength margin | at least 2.0 on the PETG datasheet yield strength (assumed, ASM-007) |
| Generated files in git | no; the matching `hw/.gitignore` is written (DR-002) |

Part numbers:
- LTL-0001 base bracket (printed)
- LTL-0002 lever (printed, bore reamed)
- LTL-0003 grooved pin (bought)
- LTL-0004 DIN 6799 - 5 ring (bought)
- LTL-0005 ISO 7380-1 M4 × 12 screw (bought)

Material data: I saved Prusa's Prusament PETG datasheet v1.1 with its checksum and use its typical values. These are datasheet figures, not guaranteed design values:
- yield strength 47 MPa
- layer-to-layer strength 18 MPa
- heat deflection temperature 68 °C

## Option comparison
The comparison tool marks the choice ready to approve; it has no major or critical findings.

| Option | Result | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| **Printed PETG bracket and lever on your MK4, reamed Ø6 H7 lever bore, bought grooved pin, DIN 6799 - 5 rings, ISO 7380 screws** | **Feasible, ranked first** | Passes every mandatory requirement it was checked against |
| Same, plus a pressed bronze bushing in the lever | Ruled out | The lever would no longer run on its own reamed Ø6 H7 bore |
| Machined aluminium bracket from an outside shop | Ruled out | Not printed in PETG on your MK4, and it needs outsourcing |

What the recommended option still has to prove:
- **Strength:** my quick hand calculation puts the safety factor at about 5.7. It assumes an 8 × 14 mm lever section, so it is only an estimate; the strength analysis later replaces it, and no measured strength is claimed.
- **Print accuracy:** your MK4 has no calibration records, so on each set the 0.3 mm side gaps, the cheek-hole clearance and the reamed bore need inspecting.
- **Bought parts:** the exact catalogue pin and the screw grade are not chosen yet (open question Q-014, settled when parts are sourced).

**Do you approve the printed PETG bracket and lever with the bought grooved pin, rings and screws as the selected option, and the assumptions ASM-001 to ASM-008?** If yes, I'll record the approval and continue to the requirements, concept variants and the VARIANT gate. Nothing moves forward until you answer.
